title: Self-Assembly of Luminescent Hexanuclear Lanthanide Salen Complexes

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear lanthanide salen cluster (two centrosymmetric Nd3L2 units linked by μ3-OH)

synthesis.procedure: Under dry oxygen-free dinitrogen using Schlenk techniques, triethylamine (4 mL of 0.1 M EtOH solution) was added to H2L1 (0.072 g, 0.20 mmol) and NdCl3·6H2O (0.072 g, 0.20 mmol) in 30 mL of MeOH. The solution was stirred and refluxed for 30 min, cooled to room temperature, and filtered. Diethyl ether was allowed to diffuse slowly into the filtrate at room temperature. Yellow single crystals of 1 were collected by filtration after 2 weeks.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques under dry N2; reflux then diethyl ether vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature, filtered; diethyl ether slow diffusion into the filtrate; yellow crystals collected by filtration after 2 weeks

properties.summary: In CH3CN, 1 shows typical Nd3+ NIR emission (4F3/2 → 4Ij/2; j = 9, 11, 13) upon ligand-centered excitation: 873 and 900 nm (4I9/2), 1063 nm (4I11/2), and 1350 nm (4I13/2). Similar NIR luminescence is observed in the solid state. Free H2L1 and NdCl3·6H2O do not exhibit NIR luminescence under similar conditions.

measurements.name: NIR emission bands (Nd3+ 4F3/2 → 4I9/2, 4I11/2, 4I13/2)
measurements.conditions: CH3CN, 298 K; ligand-centered excitation; also similar NIR emission in the solid state

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear lanthanide salen cluster, isomorphous with 1

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 1: triethylamine (4 mL of 0.1 M EtOH solution) was added to H2L1 (0.072 g, 0.20 mmol) and TbCl3·6H2O (0.075 g, 0.20 mmol) in 30 mL of MeOH. The resulting solution was treated as for 1 (stir/reflux 30 min, cool, filter, diethyl ether diffusion). Yellow single crystals of 2 were collected by filtration after 2 weeks.
synthesis.temperature: treated as for 1 (reflux then room-temperature crystallization)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: treated as above; yellow crystals collected by filtration after 2 weeks

properties.summary: In CH3CN, excitation of 2 at the ligand-centered band produces typical Tb3+ 5D4 → 7Fn (n = 6, 5, 4, 3) emission. The excitation spectrum monitoring 546 nm shows a peak at 367 nm. Ligand-centered fluorescence is quenched and typical Tb3+ excitation bands are absent, indicating efficient ligand-to-metal energy transfer. Φem = 0.17 (quinine sulfate standard).

measurements.name: fluorescence quantum yield Φem
measurements.conditions: Tb3+ complex; quinine sulfate (Φ = 0.546 in 0.5 mol dm−3 H2SO4) as standard

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear lanthanide salen cluster (two Eu3L2 units bridged by μ3-OH)

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 1: triethylamine (4 mL of 0.1 M EtOH solution) was added to H2L2 (0.060 g, 0.20 mmol) and EuCl3·6H2O (0.073 g, 0.20 mmol) in 30 mL of MeOH. The resulting solution was treated as above. Yellow single crystals of 3 were collected by filtration after 2 weeks.
synthesis.temperature: treated as for 1 (reflux then room-temperature crystallization)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: treated as above; yellow crystals collected by filtration after 2 weeks

properties.summary: Excitation of the ligand-centered absorption at 439 nm in 3 gives Eu3+ 5D0 → 7Fj (j = 1–4) visible emission. The fluorescence is weak with Φem < 10−3 ([Ru(bipy)3]Cl2 standard).

measurements.name: ligand-centered excitation wavelength for Eu3+ emission
fluorescence quantum yield Φem
measurements.conditions: Eu3+ complex; [Ru(bipy)3]Cl2 (Φ = 0.028 in water) as standard

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear lanthanide salen cluster related to 3

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 1: triethylamine (4 mL of 0.1 M EtOH solution) was added to H2L2 (0.060 g, 0.20 mmol) and ErCl3·6H2O (0.076 g, 0.20 mmol) in 30 mL of MeOH. The resulting solution was treated as above. Yellow single crystals were collected by filtration after 2 weeks.
synthesis.temperature: treated as for 1 (reflux then room-temperature crystallization)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: treated as above; yellow crystals collected by filtration after 2 weeks

properties.summary: No NIR emission due to Er3+ was observed for 4 under the experimental conditions employed. UV–vis absorption of 4 in CH3CN is ligand-based and red-shifted relative to free H2L2.

measurements.name: Er3+ NIR emission
measurements.conditions: experimental conditions used for photophysical studies (298 K; solid state and CH3CN)
